claim_boundary: This is an equation-led T-MOEA reconstruction on the same-author public WFLO-GGA Nysted assets. No source or hash evidence establishes identity with the unavailable T-MOEA experiment, cable router, candidate set, or reference front.

paper_preserved_controls.wake: Jensen deficit 2/3*(r/(r+alpha*d))^2 with alpha=0.5/ln(H/0.0002), root-sum-square superposition, and 8760-hour AEP
paper_preserved_controls.representation: ordered vector of distinct integer candidate indices
paper_preserved_controls.selection: NSGA-II nondominated rank and crowding distance
paper_preserved_controls.crossover: single-point exchange followed by order-preserving duplicate repair
paper_preserved_controls.topology_mutation: symmetrized k-nearest-neighbor isolation score; relocate the maximum-score turbine to the unused candidate nearest the layout centroid
paper_preserved_controls.random_swap: swap two chromosome positions with probability pm

declared_reconstruction_controls.duplicate_repair: retain the first occurrence in chromosome order and counter-keyed uniformly refill free candidate indices
declared_reconstruction_controls.knn_adjacency: undirected union of directed five-nearest-neighbor arcs, because a purely directed fixed-k out-degree would make the degree term constant
declared_reconstruction_controls.tie_breaks: candidate index for geometry and lexicographic chromosome order for environmental selection
declared_reconstruction_controls.physical_work: the thirty initial complete biobjective evaluations consume the first thirty budget units; 3000 FES therefore comprises initialization plus ninety-nine offspring generations
declared_reconstruction_controls.randomness: counter-keyed events independent of worker scheduling

problem_asset_authority.provenance: same-author public WFLO-GGA source converted under the existing GGA asset receipt
problem_asset_authority.identity_limit: These inputs are a declared reconstruction authority, not proof that T-MOEA used the same arrays or sampling seed.

cable_completion.router: audited WFLO-GGA balanced-substation radial routing and cable-capacity pricing
cable_completion.reason: the paper does not define a cable topology chromosome transition or a routing solver
cable_completion.limitation: the public GGA router and pricing replace the missing paper experiment implementation and installation allowance semantics

parallel_contract.worker_count: all processors visible to the job
parallel_stages: offspring parent selection, crossover, repair, topology mutation, and swap from a read-only parent generation
complete independent Jensen-AEP and cable-routing evaluations

artifact_contract.primary_result: full nondominated front with both raw objectives and ordered chromosomes
artifact_contract.replay: every stored front member must reproduce exact AEP and cable cost through evaluate-layout mode
artifact_contract.timing: end-to-end, evaluator, and algorithm orchestration are emitted separately
artifact_contract.formal_status: development only until Waffle frozen-environment execution
